caption: I timed my week. Six hours went here.
transcript: I tracked every hour last week. Six of them went to rewriting the same three emails: the showing recap, the offer-received update, and the under-contract next steps. So I wrote each one once, saved it as a template, and now I only edit the first line. I am not telling you to automate your clients. I am telling you to stop writing the same email from scratch.
